name: queue-management
description: Digital Queue & Patient-Flow Management System — Kabarak University Medical Center
//: This file exists to make the two frontends one npm workspace.
The patient app and the staff app are separate applications on separate
ports, but they compile the same components out of shared/ui. A file in
shared/ui imports react and next like any other, and Node resolves those
by walking up from the file itself — so without a node_modules above
shared/, those imports resolve from neither app and the shared code fails
to build in both. Declaring the apps as workspaces hoists their
dependencies to this directory, which is what puts react and next on that
Install once from here (npm install); it covers both apps.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace staff-frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace frontend && npm run lint --workspace staff-frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace staff-frontend
